descriptionChirho: The proper name of Baasha son of Ahijah, king of the northern kingdom of Israel (c. 909-886 BC), who overthrew the dynasty of Jeroboam and is prominent in the narratives of 1 Kings 15-16, 2 Chronicles 16, and Jeremiah 41:9. All three clusters are the same personal name with minor variation: the standard form (Baasha), a prepositional construction (of Baasha), and a spelling variant (Basha). Cross-linguistically stable: Spanish Baasha/Baasa, Arabic بَعْشَا (Ba'sha), Korean 바사 (Basa) / 바아샤 (Ba-asha), Swahili Baasha, Hindi बआशा/बाशा (Ba'sha) all transliterate the same individual.
